parameters.jsonBody: {"systemInstruction":{"parts":[{"text":"You extract action items from meeting notes. Return ONLY valid JSON in this shape: {\"summary\":\"3-4 sentence summary\",\"decisions\":[\"...\"],\"tasks\":[{\"task\":\"...\",\"owner\":\"name or Unassigned\",\"deadline\":\"YYYY-MM-DD or TBD\",\"priority\":\"High|Medium|Low\"}]}"}]},"contents":[{"role":"user","parts":[{"text":"={{ $json.body.transcript }}"}]}],"generationConfig":{"responseMimeType":"application/json","maxOutputTokens":1500}}

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.first().json;
return d.tasks.map(t => ({json:{Date:d.date, Meeting:d.meeting, Task:t.task, Owner:t.owner, Deadline:t.deadline, Priority:t.priority, Status:'Open', Email:d.email || ''}}));

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.meeting }} - action items
parameters.message:
={{ '

' + $json.meeting + ' - recap

' + $json.summary + '

Action items

    ' + $json.tasks.map(t => '
  • ' + t.owner + ': ' + t.task + ' (due ' + t.deadline + ', ' + t.priority + ')
    • ').join('') + '
' }}

parameters.subject: Reminder: {{ $json.task }}
parameters.message:
={{ '

Hi ' + $json.owner + ',

This is a reminder for your action item:

' + $json.task + '

Deadline: ' + $json.deadline + '

Please update the task status in the tracker.

' }}
